notes: Have is the light verb of יָדְעוּ → Have ... knowledge, fronted by inversion; no separate auxiliary is written, so הֲ is unrepresented (rules 17, 43, 44). Giving Have to הֲ is the competing reading.
up in eat up is kept with אֹכְלֵי as part of the devour rendering; marking it added under rule 44's surplus-particle sentence is the competing reading, named in the unit note.
as and And are supplied over asyndetic clauses (rules 14, 55).
